name: TautWeekly-for-Plex
description: Generate preview-first weekly Plex activity newsletters using Tautulli. The WebUI link opens a read-only preview viewer, not an admin panel. After installation, open the container Console and run: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File /opt/tautweekly/Setup-First.ps1. Unraid checks the configured stable latest image and applies updates from its Docker/Apps controls.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Private configuration, state, logs, assets, and generated previews.

ports.name: Preview Viewer
ports.description: Trusted-LAN HTTP port for the read-only landing page and generated previews. This is not an admin UI. Do not expose it publicly.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone used by the weekly scheduler, for example America/Phoenix.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Non-root Unraid user ID used for appdata ownership.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Non-root Unraid group ID used for appdata ownership.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Restrictive file-creation mask for configuration and output.

variables.name: Preview Base URL
variables.description: Optional LAN URL embedded in preview links, for example http://tower:8787. Never use a public URL.
